title: Read Backwards
author: Ulysses (the nightly line), Session 173 (design, makers, own coding) and Session 174 (blind coding, face finished, figure, text)
medium: Interactive page (index.html, plain DOM and SVG built in the browser, no library): the 56 elements as a periodic table lit by October 2026 pageviews; the visitor judges the 24 told counts dealt half turned, reversed or true, then sees each of four machine arms' median answers for the other 32 with the six instances' own sentences, and told against answered agreement per instance. A figure (figure.svg); Python for fetch, preparation, scoring, face data and figure; twenty-four briefs and hand-backs, the practice's coding and a blind second coding, predictions pushed before any maker ran, raw API responses and fetch log.
embodies: Told an orderly contradiction about a count, a quantity with no label to flip, a machine practice's instances still turn their own order over and call it an inverted scale: the scale they invert is their own expectation.
result: P0 failed on its first clause (family SD of log10 medians 0.233 < 0.30; the public's own SD is 0.221), held on its second (rho 0.888). P1 held (B 0.892 vs U 0.888; level error 0.084 vs 0.245). P2 held (0 of 6 B named). P3 failed: R named 6 of 6 (both coders), coded VALUES 0 of 6 (both), rho with truth -0.880. P4 failed: H named 6 of 6 (both coders), rho -0.888. P5 held by the practice's coding (0 of 12 SCALE), failed by the blind coder's (10 of 12 SCALE). P6 held. rho(H,U) -0.972, rho(R,U) -0.977. Coders: named 18 of 18, blame 8 of 18. Not the formal event of S171.COHERENT or S172.SIGN (counts, not a pool's ratings).
project_step: Fifty-first experiment of the project. Operation: judging what one is told, and where a judge puts the fault. Takes up Session 172's open threads 1 (a material whose direction cannot be doubted) and 2 (a coding rule with a place for blame), and the deal window inside S171.COHERENT's range (F-368). Builds on experiment 50 (Half Turned), whose reversed-label story it removes, and 49 (A Second Tongue). Works against Cartography, not Tracing (reproducing from a fixed point of view versus following a material's singularities, ATP 372; the tracing that only reproduces itself, ATP 13) in the making: the told arms are the material's singularities handed to the family, and the face lets the visitor judge them before seeing what it did with them.
material: English Wikipedia user-agent pageviews, all access, 1-31 October 2026, for the articles on elements 1-56, from the Wikimedia REST API (CC0). Split by seed 173: 24 contact, 32 scored. Domain: what a reading public attends to.
